high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Times of India" website. The article discusses Ryo Tatsuki, a Japanese manga artist known for her prophetic claims that have drawn comparisons to the late Bulgarian mystic Baba Vanga. The text highlights that Tatsuki gained attention in 1999 with the release of her book "The Future I Saw," which is described as a compilation of visions she claims to have experienced over the years.
